I went through all six of Moss's notes and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers. I sent Dana the list in our direct message:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025): drivers at the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed it was fixed.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated): the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It was escalated to tier-2 support.

The details on #4419 don't agree. A note from Marcus (14 Jul 2025, not one of Moss's) also lists #4419 for Quarrendon, but describes it as printer lag at Gate 3. I told Dana to check the ticket itself before putting it in the weekly notes.

The other Moss notes have no Quarrendon tickets. The two Central notes mention #4409 and #4412, but those are for Pree's account, so I left them off the list. Everything I used is in public files, so nothing in the answer comes from a place Dana can't see.
